_comment_freezable: (10,17) is the north edge of the fishing-pond blocking rect (x7-13, y17-21 walls.segments). It is already impassable water, so unfrozen it changes NOTHING for any floodplains route (every ambush/Relc/gate lane is unchanged -- confirmed off the pond). Approaching from the open floor at (10,16) and casting [Snap Freeze] freezes it into walkable ice; stepping onto it and facing down reaches the `frozen_cache` prop at (10,18) (pond interior, otherwise unreachable). The 'secret' is that only a cold-caster can cross the water to it. Ice thaws at sleep. No QA drives this (the seam is proven by sewers_walkthrough); it ships as reachable content.
_comment: World environment. Reachable via the walkable inn_door route (inn_door -> floodplains (7,6); floodplains_peek was retired once this route landed, see CLAUDE.md). POI anchors: fishing-pond (13,18), ruin-stones interact (31,7). `goblin_encounter_1` sits at (30,23) with `trigger_radius: 2` -- the wall `segments` at y=25 block every column except x=31 (`liscor_gate`'s own cell), so (31,24) is the UNIQUE open cell from which the gate can be reached/interacted -- and (31,24) sits inside the 5x5 Chebyshev-2 square around (30,23) (x:[28,32], y:[21,25]). Any 4-directional path from outside that square to (31,24) (which lies inside it) must enter the square before arriving, so no route to `liscor_gate` avoids the ambush (BFS-proven). `goblin_encounter_2` (28,18) and `chieftains_raid` (31,7) are unaffected (interact-only, no trigger_radius) and sit well outside this zone.

entities._comment: The inn's iconic sign, canon-fixed wording (ch. 1.18) -- "THE WANDERING INN — NO KILLING GOBLINS", posted "on a sign right in front of the inn, by the door" (the exact-wording loophole ch. 4.33 is part of its character, not implemented here). entities.toast: A hand-painted board, letters gone bold where they were traced twice: THE WANDERING INN — NO KILLING GOBLINS.
entities.observe: The paint is newer than the post it hangs on. Somebody meant it, and means it still.

entities._comment: A lost cache on the pond floor at (10,18), inside the fishing-pond blocking rect and thus unreachable UNLESS the player frost-freezes the pond edge (10,17) and steps onto the ice to interact it (see the floodplains `freezable` list). Interact-only, banks `found_the_frozen_cache` (opaque) + a flavor toast. Sits on an already-blocked pond cell, so it alters no route and no script reaches or asserts it. Sprite `crate` stands in for a silt-buried strongbox (VISUAL-LOG flag). Issue #81 (exploration & optional content): the economy pass this comment used to flag -- 'a future economy pass can hang gold/an item off this discovery' -- lands here. `gold: 5` rides the SAME on_interact_accomplishment branch's existing optional `gold` field (wi_game.gd's interact(), the serving_tray/patron precedent), fired AFTER the atmospheric toast above (record_accomplishment -> toast -> gold -> its own 'Earned 5 gold.' toast) -- the flavor text is untouched, this is additive only. `bounty_pond_keepsakes` (data/bounties.json) now also reads found_the_frozen_cache for a small board bonus, so the one secret this game shipped that paid literally nothing now pays gold directly AND feeds a posting. Still 'No QA drives this' (the freeze-cross mechanic itself remains a deliberately disclosed gap, per the original note) -- this task did not add fixture/canonical coverage for the reward, consistent with that pre-existing, accepted scope.
entities.observe: Something square and man-made rests on the pond floor a stride out from the bank, furred with silt. Too far to reach across open water. But water can be made to bear weight, if you know the trick of cold.
entities.toast: Kneeling on the ice, you lever the silt-caked strongbox free. Drake-work, old, its lock long rusted through. Inside, dry against all odds, a few keepsakes someone drowned here meant never to be found.

variants.toast: The strongbox sits open and empty now, holding nothing but pond-light.

entities._comment: `on_enter_accomplishment` banks `reached_liscor` on door travel INTO the street (the Act I gate's street-arrival counter). Fires ONLY on real door interaction (the `door` branch of interact()), never on QA teleport or save/load restore (those use bind_map_silent/transition without the entity), so a load can never spuriously advance the act. record_accomplishment is idempotent for gate purposes (>= 1). DISCLOSURE: every canonical script that walks floodplains -> liscor_gate -> street now carries reached_liscor:1 in its snapshot (additive counter; no script asserts an exact accomplishments dict).

Issue #62 finding 8: RETIRED to one-shot -- `respawns: true` used to leave this armed forever (dormant-until-next-sleep, re-arming every waking), so the same ambush kept springing on every trip past the gate, sleep after sleep, long after the tutorial beat it exists for was long over. `respawns` (and its now-dead `repeat_arena`/`tutorial_seen_when` pair, which only ever mattered for a POST-dormancy re-arm) are gone outright: resolve_combat's existing `elif not persistent: remove_entity(...)` arm (already shipped, no new sim mechanism) now fires on this entity's first victory, same as any ordinary one-shot encounter -- it is gone from the map for good afterward, exactly like goblin_encounter_2. riverfarm's river_wolf_pack pair keeps `respawns: true` (deliberate, unrelated -- a night-only recurring danger, not a one-time tutorial beat). This arena's own tutor_lines close on road_clear's sign line ("See the sign? Her inn, her rule. The road's the road. Teeth are teeth out here. But under her roof? Don't.") -- the shipped resolution moment for holding the inn's no-killing-goblins rule on the road; sign_defended (below) still banks once, satisfying the Garden gate's K-of-4 read (`accomplishment_count` >=1, unaffected by this fight now being unrepeatable).

entities.observe: A Drake built like a barracks door, spear worn smooth from use, standing at ease the way only dangerous people stand. He watches the road and everyone on it. Including you, now.
entities.friendly_line: Heh. Alright, alright - I like you. You've got the look of someone who buys a guy a drink after. We're good, you and me. Best guardsman in Liscor says so.
entities._comment_stages: Talk_pool lifted verbatim from the S2 dropped-but-authored copy (.superpowers/sdd/fp-handoff/task-s2-social-report.md, Dropped-but-authored). talk_pool_stages + the relc_intro.json meet-topic unlocks (relc_army/relc_after) lifted verbatim from docs/design/social-2-staging/relc_stages.json after the re-path wave went green. relc_after's daughter/Embria reveal stays OUT (V5 canon, hard rail -- the staged oblique 'people I left in it' copy is what ships). Stage 3's spar-wager perk refinement stays UNBUILT/flagged (status quo: relc_spar already re-offers).
talk_pool: Heh. You walk like nobody's ever hit you properly. We should fix that sometime - for fun.
Road's boring today. I keep hoping something stupid charges the gate so I can try out the old Relc Headbutt.
You gonna eat that? ...No? Shame. Guarding's hungry work, and I'm the best there is at it.
Stand up straight, kid. Best guardsman in Liscor is watching this road. That's me. Obviously.
You met Klb yet? Senior Guardsman, four arms, does paperwork like it's a Skill. Best partner in the Watch. Tell him he owes me a drink — he'll say ants don't drink. He's lying.

lines: Hah! There's my favorite punching bag. Kidding. The dummies are my favorite. You're a close third after lunch.
You're standing straighter. See that? That's me. I'm basically a [Teacher]. Don't tell the Watch, they'll dock my pay for moonlighting.
Quiet shift. If anything with teeth shows up, you'll hear me laughing before you hear the bell.
There they are. You know what I like about you? You went DOWN the creepy hole. Most people file a report about the hole. From upstairs.
Zevara smiled this week. Actual smile. The warren's sealed and the city's still standing. I'm taking full credit and handing you most of it.
Next time something ugly crawls out of the ground, I'm not even worried. That's new for me. Don't make it weird.

entities.observe: Straw and burlap lashed to posts, hacked half to ribbons. Someone drills here often, and hard. The stitching tells you where a real guard would break.

entities.observe: A hairline crack runs through old, dressed stone half-swallowed by turf -- not natural rock, something built. Cold air breathes up out of it, and it smells of somewhere else.
entities.toast: A cold seam splits the earth here, sealed by old stone. It doesn't feel like it goes anywhere. Yet.

door_when.open_toast: The seam splits wider at your touch, cold air breathing out of the dark beneath. You step through, into somewhere else.

entities._comment: Issue #24 (HR-II forward-ref): bounty_crab_cull's own encounter bank. NO trigger_radius -- the ambush-one-shot lesson (goblin_encounter_1/river_wolf_pack) doesn't apply here: this is a renewable cull target a player CHOOSES to pick a fight with, not a proximity danger sprung on them. Interact opens the `crab_nest` confirm conversation (review-wave M1 controller ruling, the awakened_boss/relc_descent confirm shape: the node text telegraphs the armor, [Strike first.] fires the fight via a start_combat dialogue effect, [Back away.] leaves it live and re-interactable -- informed consent for a fresh classless player; see data/dialogue/crab_nest.json's own TRAP note for the dormant-re-interact edge). respawns:true (staging note's own recommendation, docs/archive/staging/board-staging/guild-bounties.json's bounty_crab_cull _notes -- a rotating bounty that can only complete once is a design smell) -- the entity goes dormant until the next sleep re-arms it, same mechanism river_wolf_pack/alley_footpads already use, just without their trigger_radius half. `allies`/`ally_requires` mirror every other floodplains fight (goblin_encounter_1/2, chieftains_raid): Relc fields once met_relc is banked, solo before that. Placed at (21,16) -- verified off every canonical floodplains route the same way ruin_door's own placement comment documents: replayed every qa/scripts/*.json crossing this map (move/assert_state/teleport-aware simulator, entry cells (7,6)/(31,24)/(37,11) per the three floodplains doors) and confirmed the nearest walked cell is Chebyshev 7 away (class_evolution_loop's own x=28 corridor); nearest existing entity is goblin_encounter_2 at (28,18), Chebyshev 7; nearest blocked cell is the (24,19) boulder at Chebyshev 3 -- close enough to read as the SAME boulder field without colliding with it. Sprite `rock_crab` (data/sprites.json) is a genuine crab pick (Admurin Enemy_Galore_I/Crab), pre-tinted stone-grey in the shipped asset itself (see assets_manifest.json's own trace) rather than an entity-level `tint` override, since the fight needs the SAME palette in both field and combat and combat sprites have no runtime tint hook. NO `loot` table (unlike goblin_encounter_1/2) -- deliberate: the bounty's OWN turn-in payout is the canonical proof surface (`crab_cull_loop`'s gold-exact assertion), and fight loot rolls off an isolated per-encounter rng stream keyed to the QA CLI `--seed` (independent of the fixture's own combat rng_state) -- adding a chance-based gold drop here would make that assertion seed-dependent for no gameplay reason (river_wolf_pack, the other respawns:true precedent, carries no loot table either).
